The PHP sources in this directory come from [Setasign/tFPDF v1.33](https://github.com/Setasign/tFPDF/tree/v1.33), distributed under LGPL 2.1. The library remains separate from application code. Text whitespace is normalized. The Unicode font cache can be disabled by subclasses to prevent concurrent exports from writing to the source directory.

DejaVu Sans is bundled under its own license in `font/unifont/DejaVu_LICENSE.txt`.
